what: The planned fail-closed test permits a non-empty TOOL-only token-record even though append-token-record.sh processes any non-empty sidecar into a zero-total vendor row
scenario_or_breakage: An empty pre-touched file is safe because append-token-record.sh exits on ! -s, and token-cost only warns when aggregate tokens are >0, but a TOOL-only sidecar would still violate the stated no ledger row contract and the proposed test would not catch it
suggested_fix: Tighten test-launch-codex-ci.sh to require the no-usage token-record to be zero-byte or absent, then run append-token-record.sh and assert no codex row is appended; remove the TOOL-only allowance
